events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the Woodstock Festival brought together half a million people for three days of peace and music. What was your favourite Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977. He would have been 91.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and iconic style continue to influence generations.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the unparalleled guitar genius, Jimi Hendrix. His innovative sound changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: An album cover that launched a thousand theories and a tracklist of timeless hits. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was released 57 years ago today.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and songwriting with The Pretenders continue to rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher is 54 today! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the rock 'n' roll star?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007, from classic cool to modern espionage. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire peace and imagination.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: We remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the magnificent Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?
